notes:
- DT Reverb — random-pop fix: eliminated the intermittent pops/clicks that could occur on idle or paused tracks. The reverb now declares an honest tail length (so the host no longer sleeps the effect mid-ring), its spectrum analyzer runs fully lock-free off the audio thread, and its silence handling drains cleanly to true zero. DT Delay also declares an honest tail so long repeats never get cut.
- DT Reverb — engine overhaul: the feedback network was rebuilt with double the modal density for a smoother, denser, less "metallic" tail, with decorrelated stereo output for cleaner lows and a softer onset.
- DT Reverb — expanded preset library: a large, re-voiced set spanning air/ambience, small+big spaces, rooms, halls, plates, chambers, plus dedicated vocal and drum presets — each shaped with a low-cut/high-cut so it sits in a mix out of the box.
- Undo / Redo: fixed undo over-shooting, and (inside a DAW) DT plug-ins no longer hijack the host's own Edit → Undo/Redo. Continuous knob drags collapse into a single undo step.
- DT Multiband Compressor: loudness-match no longer floods the undo history; auto-gain writes are throttled so Redo stays available.
- Stability: a universal safety net on every DT effect scrubs non-finite samples and hard-limits runaway levels, so nothing can produce an ear-damaging spike.
- Each plug-in still checks for updates when it opens and shows an in-DAW banner when a new DT version is available.
